Unit = the trade, not the deposit
Revenue = trade size × frequency × full fee (0.017%). We monetize the $50–$50K full-fee retail ticket (base fee tier). The top cohort $5K–$50K is ~10% of trades but ~74% of fees — on perp, leverage lifts a retail deposit's notional there, still at full fee. Above $50K = institutional, off-ICP.
